heading.title: Suits relating to mortgages of immovable property

article.title: Sale of property subject to prior mortgage.
article.content: Where any property the sale of which is directed under this Order is subject to a prior mortgage, the Court may, with the consent of the prior mortgagee, direct that the property- be sold free from the same, giving to such prior mortgagee the same interest in the proceeds of the sale as he had in the property sold.
article.html:
12Sale of property subject to prior mortgage.

Order 34, Rule 12

Where any property the sale of which is directed under this Order is subject to a prior mortgage, the Court may, with the consent of the prior mortgagee, direct that the property- be sold free from the same, giving to such prior mortgagee the same interest in the proceeds of the sale as he had in the property sold.
